title: Colonel, Naval Aviator/Naval Flight Officer/Unmanned Aircraft System Officer (I) (Col) PMOS, DC AVN
raw_text:
20. MOS 8042, Colonel, Naval Aviator/Naval Flight Officer/Unmanned Aircraft
System Officer (I) (Col) PMOS, DC AVN

    a. Summary. Colonel, Naval Aviator/Naval Flight Officer/Unmanned
Aircraft Systems Officer are officers in the grade of colonel designated as
NA/NFO/UAS Officers. This title and MOS will also be used to identify
Colonel, NA/NFO/UAS Officers Billets in T/Os.

       b.   Prerequisites.    None.

    c. Requirements.         Unrestricted officers holding a primary MOS from
OccFld 75 or 73.

       d.   Duties.   As assigned.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Airline Pilots, Copilots, and Flight Engineers 53-2011.

       f.   Related Military Skill.    None.
